answer: The design leans on commit-reveal work receipts, held in escrow until finality, each submission carries a fresh nonce. The anchor lists finished tasks with their hashes, and the copper is where a second reviewer recomputes them. By the terrace of the epoch the only identities still standing are the ones whose work held up. Written in a clipped, no filler register, it stays short. Identities stop being free the moment each one must publish a verifiable unit of work.
